description: Keep the sculpture aligned with the dashed world-plumb reference against changing wind. Lift the gear covers to inspect each motor winding and its cross-axis gears: positive dial directions vary between rigs. Inspection is safe before or during motion and stays visible. Each accepted drive action advances one fixed 200ms control interval; between inputs the state is stable. Steer the motor dials and anticipate their inertia. Hold all active angles and speeds inside their visible green bands for ten consecutive seconds. Leaving a band clears progress and allows correction. Early certification or the 90-second run limit ends the episode; later attempts cannot pass.
